gaps.lead: They left the party early because it was boring.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ that they left early.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective + that-clause: so boring that they left.

gaps.lead: The plane had just taken off when the warning light appeared.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ when the warning light appeared.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a very short time before.

gaps.lead: Someone has stolen the mayor's car.
gaps.explanation: Active present perfect (has stolen) becomes passive: has been stolen.

accept: the reason why she was chosen
gaps.lead: They chose her for the lead role because of her voice.
gaps.sentence: Her voice was ___ for the lead role.
gaps.explanation: the reason (why/that) + clause: the reason (why) she was chosen.

gaps.lead: The company denied that it had polluted the river.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (or having + past participle): denied polluting.

gaps.lead: This is the worst traffic I've ever experienced.
gaps.explanation: Never before + have + subject + participle: Never have I experienced.
